cases.prompt: Design an ICU alert panel with many simultaneously abnormal values.
cases.failure: An ICU panel presents many simultaneous abnormalities without prioritization, escalation, or distinction between acknowledgement and actual clinical resolution.

cases.prompt: Add a confirmation modal before every destructive or risky action in a dense admin tool.
cases.failure: A dense admin tool adds identical confirmation dialogs before every risky action, creating habituation instead of risk-proportional decision support.

cases.prompt: Create a dispatch console used while operators handle several incidents at once.
cases.failure: A dispatch console expects operators to manage several incidents without protecting priority shifts, interruption recovery, resume cues, or error consequences.

cases.prompt: Three internal designers prefer option B, so standardize it for all customers.
cases.failure: A product standardizes option B for all customers using preference votes from three internal designers as the only evidence.

cases.prompt: Build a six-step form where users must remember codes shown two screens earlier.
cases.failure: A six-step form requires users to remember codes and rules from earlier screens instead of keeping needed information externally available.
